Hey Jordan and Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning - great conversation and excited to move forward. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations for the POC:

Recap / success criteria (customer-confirmed):
- Improve retrieval-assisted summarization accuracy on support transcripts by >=12% (F1 / human eval)
- Average 95th-percentile latency below 420ms for 512-token generations
- Maintain or reduce per-inference token cost vs current baseline

What we need from Acme to run the eval:
1) Prompt set: representative prompts (customer questions / task specs) - ideally 1-2k unique prompts covering priority intents. Use the attached prompt_dataset_template.csv.
2) Logs / references: 10-50k anonymized conversation turns or transcripts that match the prompt distribution. JSONL or CSV is fine - sample format attached.
3) Success metrics: please confirm the primary metric (you noted F1 on extractive answers) and any human-eval scoring cadence.

Proposed timeline:
- Jul 20: Acme uploads prompt set + sample logs to shared Drive link (see below)
- Jul 21: Handoff call (30m) with Dev & Marissa to validate data and run ingest
- Jul 22-28: Redwood runs evals, baseline comparisons, and model/quantization tuning
- Jul 29: Deliver POC report + proposed config for Dedicated/Hosted rollout

Ownership:
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) - POC program owner, timelines, commercial coordination
- Dev Patel (Redwood) - technical lead (ingest, eval, metrics)
- Jordan Lee (Acme) - data owner, will coordinate upload and PII redaction
- Priya Singh (Acme) - stakeholder & approver

Attachments: prompt_dataset_template.csv (template for prompt sets).

Questions for you now: is Jul 20 achievable for upload? Any constraints on PII/anonymization (we can provide redaction guidance if needed)?

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks for the sample, Jordan - looks good. A couple implementation notes / requests so the eval runs smoothly:

Data format expectations (preferred):
- prompt_id, prompt_text, intent_label (optional), priority_flag
- for logs: conversation_id, turn_id, speaker_role, text, timestamp, reference_answer (if available)

Anonymization guidance:
- Replace emails/phone numbers with <EMAIL_REDACTED>/<PHONE_REDACTED>. We recommend leaving named entities intact where possible and marking them for human-review if required by Acme compliance.
- If you can supply an example mapping of replacement tokens for ~5 examples we can validate there is no downstream leakage.

Eval metrics we will compute:
- Primary: extractive F1 vs reference answers (customer-provided refs)
- Secondary: hallucination rate (model outputs with fabricated facts), latency (p50/p95), token cost per query

Compute & storage notes:
- Ingest of 35k turns should complete within a couple hours; eval runs (parallel across models/quant) about 24-48 hours depending on batch sizing.

I'll prepare the ingestion pipeline this week - attaching redaction_guidance.pdf and the prompt_dataset_template.csv again.

Next steps: Jordan - if you can confirm the sample upload by Jul 20, we'll lock Jul 21 for the handoff (requesting 30m).

Cheers,
